_about: How to estimate XP remaining in a student's Math Academy course from Timeback alone. The size of every course is Timeback's own course.metadata.metrics.totalXp, which the school sets from Math Academy's published XP-with-reviews figure per course. Read it LIVE from GET /ims/oneroster/rostering/v1p2/courses/{course.sourcedId}; this file carries the rules and points at the course ids, never a copy of the figure. remaining ~ course.metadata.metrics.totalXp x (1 - pctCompleteApp/100).
rules: Take the student's current Math Academy enrollment (active, in its date window, primary preferred) and read enrollment.metadata.pctCompleteApp and course.sourcedId.
GET the course by sourcedId and read metadata.metrics.totalXp. remaining = totalXp x (1 - pctCompleteApp/100), basis 'timeback course XP'.

totalXp absent on the course (the bare 'Math Academy' course and the Beyond AI courses) -> no estimate, and the enrollment is the finding: no real student belongs in those courses (owner rule 2026-09-17; every active enrollment there that day was a flagged test user). Report a non-test student found there as a roster defect.

SAT Math Prep (use = never) -> no estimate at all: Math Academy reports an estimated SAT score there instead of progress, so pctCompleteApp on that course is stale or absent. SAT Math Fundamentals still reports progress and is estimated like any other course.
pctCompleteApp absent on the enrollment -> no estimate yet (no percent-bearing event since this enrollment began; DICTIONARY trap 3).

The course figure is expected to equal Math Academy's XP-with-reviews for that course (checked and matching for every course carrying a figure on 2026-09-17); if it lags a re-size the estimate reads low, and DICTIONARY trap 11 carries the measuring query.
accuracy_note: Spot-checked 2026-09-17 on ten recently active students against Math Academy's exact xpRemaining: the estimate ran low on seven of ten, typically by 20 to 45 percent, because Math Academy awards extra XP on failed reviews and retries. Treat it as 'a lot left / a little left / nearly done', never as the exact figure; the exact figure is only in the Math Academy API.
courses_note: Course ids and titles are in reference/timeback-math-academy-courses.json; regenerate with GET .../courses/?filter=title~'Math Academy'.
retired: Until 2026-09-17 this file carried a per-course size calibrated against the Math Academy API. The owner ruled that Timeback's course totalXp is the figure to use and corrected the eight courses whose figure was low the same day; the calibration was removed so there is one basis, read live.
